about: Board to story, one row per approved board: `pnpm lab:board <id>` draws the board from its own source and the app's lab story, and compares them. `board` is the page under docs/design/v7/boards/src with its parameters (the theme is added), `image` the approved image in the archive (origin/w33/boards-archive), `story` and `state` the lab story that feeds the app's real modules the board's content, `regions` the parts of the window as [x, y, width, height] in CSS px. A row with `scope` is the reference for the regions it names only (another row's board is the reference for the rest: board 12's sidebar is K02's, the owner's later decision); a region of six numbers [x, y, width, height, dx, dy] says the app's part sits dx, dy from the board's (a later board moved what is around it). A row's `note` says an owner-decided difference between the app and its board: not a failure.

S23-finished.note: The fixture switches on what is not built yet (Edit from here, Fork: `info.later`), which the app does not show; the lapsed blank's guess is the fixture's (`blank.guess`).

S33-changed.title: Board S33: a setting changed mid-session: one line in the thread with the extra cost
S33-changed.note: S33 is the reference for the line a changed setting leaves (the sliders glyph, the words, the extra cost in mono at its end) and for the composer under it; the line is measured where the app draws it, 32 lower than the board's. The thread around it is S20's and S23's: the app's finished turn keeps its foot (the model and its time; S23), and its running turn has its work line and the turn's clock, which S33's still leaves out. The turn runs, so the composer carries Stop (owner, 25 November). The fixture's cost is the board's "+$0.04"; the live app says the tokens read again without the cache, because nothing holds a price for a model yet.

S37-nomodel.note: The fixture switches on the worktree selector the board draws ("New worktree": `info.later`), which the app does not show until that choice exists. The block's buttons go to Settings, Models, at that lab's sign-in.

S41-noproject.title: Board S41: no project: "Add a folder to start" on the canvas and in the composer
S41-noproject.note: S41 is measured for the canvas and the composer under it ("Add a folder to start"). The canvas differs by "Import sessions", which is not shown until importing exists. The sidebar's "No sessions yet" and the title pill's "Sessions" are S41's too and are not converted yet (step 6b): the app says "No sessions yet. Start one with New session." in the middle of the sidebar and titles the pill "New session".

K04-card.title: Board K04: a bot's card (its head, its messages, its ask, its composer)
K04-card.note: As the board by the lead's decisions (26 November): the standing answer names the ask's scope ("Always for staging"; shown only with `approval-rules`, which this fixture switches on), the Well keeps the boards' corner of 10, and the ask and the composer sit at the card's foot, 12 over the row. What still differs: your bubble's fill is the kit's derivation from nina's colour (section 18.1: the least darkening that holds 4.5:1 under white, #e2284e) where the board writes #d42746 by hand.
